FLOOP'S LAB AND SARGE'S GEAREvery invention with its film and what it does, then everything Sarge can carry or wear, read straight out of Green vs Tan v29.49 on Nov 2, 2026. Tap anything for its sheet.

88 inventions (82 in the lab, 6 shelved) · 88 films · 43 trophies never sold · 5 irons · 116 pieces on 8 rails. The films are the lab's own television clips; they play as you scroll. Sibling page: the Boss Dashboard.

THE INVENTIONS Floop's Lab, room by room, in the order the rooms open

How the lab works: each room belongs to one man or one of Sarge's irons. Floop researches one sold part at a time; when his clock runs out the part waits at the counter for its price in stars. A won part is a trophy: never sold, it lands in its room the day it is earned (a boss, a ladder rung, an invasion). Every owned part has an ON/OFF switch, so a downside is always the player's choice. Shelved parts are off the bench today and shown for the record. The television on each card is the part's own film from the game.

SARGE'S GEAR SARGE'S EQUIPMENT at the fort: the irons, then the rack rail by rail

How the rack works: one iron in hand; one piece per rail at a time (OVER THE ARMOR stacks, the glasses go with any face piece). Each piece trades something for something: the ▲ and ▼ rows are THE MAGIC LENS's own words from the rack. Sold pieces cost stars at SARGE'S EQUIPMENT; won pieces come from a park ladder, a boss tier, the elite ladder, the torch or a box, and hide on the rack until earned. His lab parts stand in THE INVENTIONS under PISTOLS, SHOTGUN, SNIPER, SABER, CLAYMORE and SARGE.

the jet pack, the saber's crystals, the Claymore's philosophies, the mannequins and his gear sets

THE JET PACK Commander level 40

SARGE EARNED THE JET PACK. The campaign's prize! One button in battle sends him flying

THE SABER'S CRYSTALS one in the hilt speaks · TELEKINESIS puts its power on a button

  • THE BLUE CRYSTAL FORCE POPA wall throws every shot back, then a blast throws them all away.
  • THE RED CRYSTAL DASH SLAMHe dashes to the nearest enemy and slams the blade down.
  • THE GREEN CRYSTAL GHOST WALKHe vanishes and walks right past them, then swings faster.
  • THE PURPLE CRYSTAL THE LEAPHe leaps across the rug and lands hard.
  • THE ORANGE CRYSTAL HEALING CIRCLEHe plants the blade and heals every man in his circle. They hit harder too.
  • THE TEAL CRYSTAL OVERDRIVEHe dashes from enemy to enemy and throws their shots back.
  • THE YELLOW CRYSTAL RICOCHETThe blade flies out, strikes the nearest enemies one after another, and comes back.
  • THE SILVER CRYSTAL SILVER SURGEEvery man near him shoots farther. earned only

THE CLAYMORE'S PHILOSOPHIES picked when THE COMMANDER is in hand; two with THE EMPEROR'S BLADE

  • THE CLAYMORE
  • THE DUELIST

  • INSPIRE opens at level 150
